name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source subscription billing and payments platform with the Kaui admin UI, a REST API and a bundled MariaDB database.

alerts.message: Sign in to Kaui as admin with the KB_ADMIN_PASSWORD value from the environment, then create a tenant before adding accounts or catalogs.
Kill Bill and Kaui each run in their own JVM. Upstream recommends at least 4 GB of RAM on the server, otherwise the containers can crash on startup.
